proposition: A copy of Sharḥ al-Basmala went to Qāżīzāda Rūmī, on the evidence of a letter from him to Ibn Turka in the margin of MS Majlis 10196 f. 153a, and the manuscript has a marginal dedication to Ulugh Beg on f. 332b.

mediation.who: Qāżīzāda Rūmī writing to Ibn Turka (marginal letter)
mediation.note: R4 did not read the letter itself; only Melvin-Koushki's pointer

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
mediation.note: the entry calls it a dedication in the margin; who wrote it is not stated
